description.de: Prüft scripts/setup.sh auf einer frischen Linux-Maschine im Container — von nackt über --install bis zum Login — und schreibt einen Report mit Terminal-Mitschnitt und Screenshots. Kein KI-Aufruf. Variable way (host, container, staged) wählt den Weg wie Schritt 2 von setup.sh; container und staged brauchen den Docker dieses Rechners.
description.en: Checks scripts/setup.sh on a fresh Linux machine in a container — from bare over --install to the login — and writes a report with terminal transcript and screenshots. No AI call. Variable way (host, container, staged) picks the path like step 2 of setup.sh; container and staged need this machine's Docker.

author: MySuricates
instructions: Deterministic run without AI: the probe script decides GREEN/RED itself. Needs Docker on the host; the path of the report is at the end of the output.

config.label: Check the installer on a fresh machine
config.command:
set -euo pipefail
# Revision under test: variable ref (default main). The probe script comes from exactly this revision,
# not from the branch currently checked out — so the run checks what a clone of ref gets.
set -- {{ ref }}; REF="${1:-main}"
# Way the probe checks (variable way, default host): host | container | staged – like step 2 of setup.sh.
# container and staged need this machine's Docker.
set -- {{ way }}; WAY="${1:-host}"
REPO={{ project_path }}
TMP="$(mktemp -d)"; trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
red() { echo "gate_status: RED"; echo "gate_category: installer"; echo "gate_description: $1"; exit 1; }
git -C "$REPO" rev-parse --verify --quiet "${REF}^{commit}" >/dev/null || red "Unknown revision: ${REF}"
git -C "$REPO" archive "$REF" scripts | tar -x -C "$TMP"
[ -f "$TMP/scripts/installer-probe.sh" ] || red "Revision ${REF} does not contain scripts/installer-probe.sh yet"
case "$WAY" in host|container|staged) ;; *) red "Unknown way: ${WAY} (allowed: host, container, staged)" ;; esac
# Older revisions do not know --way; so call it without the option for the host way.
WAY_ARGS=(); [ "$WAY" = host ] || WAY_ARGS=(--way "$WAY")
set +e
bash "$TMP/scripts/installer-probe.sh" --repo "$REPO" --ref "$REF" "${WAY_ARGS[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$TMP/probe.out"
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
set -e
# Without gate lines of its own (abort before the checks) the verdict would otherwise be silently green.
grep -q '^gate_status:' "$TMP/probe.out" || red "Installer probe aborted (exit ${RC}) before it could check"
exit "$RC"
